narr: A cold front laid along the lower Ohio Valley on the afternoon of August 10th and resulted in diurnally driven showers and thunderstorms. The combination of slow moving and repetitive storms making their way through eastern Kentucky, an area that had been slammed with rain the day before, led to instances of flash flooding in Boyd and Lawrence Counties. Aside from minor flooding on local roads, a few homes were surrounded by water and one swift water rescue was conducted to save a citizen who found themselves stuck within the floodwaters.
ev: In Ashland, flooding was observed along West New Buckley Road with several yards and basements inundated with water. A water rescue was conducted along Beach Street.
Flooding was observed along Highway 1760 near the Cordell township.
